patterns: Teaser day becomes a three-post day: Dune: Part Three made up about 21% of hit views. DiscussingFilm's 'new teaser' post did 5,062,343, then a single-beat follow-up (Pattinson's voice as Scytale) did 3,882,790 and the Leto II/Ghanima look did 761,010.

One magazine cover story, a dozen posts: the Entertainment Weekly Avengers: Doomsday package fed 19 posts (about 23% of hit views). Beast's first look did 2,030,063, Patrick Stewart's final-day speech 818,807, Magneto 752,844, Feige quotes 643,499.

Games crossing into film and TV travel far: the Red Dead Redemption film/TV rights report (4,464,527), a TMNT easter egg in GTA 6 (1,209,230), Fortnite's Scott Pilgrim (584,420) and Puss in Boots (431,290) collabs were about 15% of hit views.
Records with a superlative in the hook: 'most-viewed Disney trailer of all time' (364,576) and 'biggest Monday ever for the franchise' (FilmUpdates 539,248; DiscussingFilm 288,439).
Cryptic one-liners work for huge accounts: DiscussingFilm's five-word 'Kenny will return tomorrow.' did 2,208,615 with no context.

Small accounts win with ranked lists and behind-the-scenes stories: CinemaTweets1's Fincher top 10 ranking (100,644) was its best; ATRightMovies' Carrie Fisher anecdote (50,964); RottenTomatoes' Rings of Power Certified Fresh (62,014).
narrative_synthesis: Dune: Part Three's new teaser and the Avengers: Doomsday EW cover story split the day (about 44% of hit views together), with game-to-screen news (Red Dead Redemption rights, GTA 6, Fortnite) a strong third.
